papers.title: Software as a Story: Narrative Architecture as the Cognitive Foundation of Sovereign Agent Systems
papers.review_status: Internally reviewed by multi-model consortium (Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, Moonshot Kimi)
papers.abstract: Software is not like a story — software IS a story. Chain-of-Thought, ReAct, and Tree of Thoughts are Aristotelian plot structures executed by machines. Corporate software is a sealed text; open-source sovereign code is a writerly chronicle with preserved provenance.

papers.title: The Sovereign Ledger: Distributed Deterministic Provenance as the Cryptographic Foundation of Decentralized Agent Trust
papers.review_status: Internally reviewed by multi-model consortium (Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, Moonshot Kimi)
papers.abstract: Trust in an agent is a deterministic function of its verifiable provenance chain. Traces a 40-year lineage: Usenet NNTP → Merkle trees → Nakamoto → BeyondCorp → SLSA/in-toto/Sigstore → SSI/DIDs. Trust ceases to be a social arrangement and becomes a computable function.

papers.title: The Tripartite Quorum: Three-Node Consensus as the Geometric Minimum for Decentralized Truth
papers.review_status: Internally reviewed by multi-model consortium (Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, Moonshot Kimi)
papers.abstract: 1 is a fluke. 2 is a coincidence. 3 is Consensus. Proved across 7 disciplines: BFT, Hegel's dialectic, Peirce's semiotics, Poincaré's 3-body problem, TMR, Arrow's impossibility theorem, and Reynolds' Boids.

papers.title: The General Theory of Sovereign Resonance: Physics Metaphors as the Architectural Foundation of Distributed Sovereign Intelligence
papers.abstract: Posits S = I × c² — Sovereignty = InferenceMass × ConsensusVelocity². Intelligence is not a cloud product but a curvature of local infrastructure. Unifies distributed systems architecture with relativistic physics, black hole thermodynamics, and Tesla resonance harmonics into a single theoretical framework.

Full sovereignty is the goal, not the current state of development.
